method: Exhaustive path/blob/mode/byte full Git tree comparison; classification is metadata inventory only, never literal semantic source review. Historic exact-source original and current inventories preserved.

interpretation.unchanged_source_reasoning: Only same physical line exact content rechecked can reuse original semantic interpretation.
interpretation.nontext: Git tree paths/modes/bytes do not prove UTF-8 or binary; explicit content classification remains due.
interpretation.renames: No removed paths in these two trees but copied/moved semantic code may still exist.
